meta.method: GA4 weekly users are deduplicated: one report call per Mon-Sun week with no date dimension, never summed from daily rows. GA4 bookings = create path only (see basis_change). Google bookings use metrics.all_conversions filtered to conversion action 'Hutong Dubai (web) sevenrooms_booking_complete' (the GA4-imported action) only. Meta bookings = schedule_total. trend8/funnel spend and bookings = Meta + Google combined. funnel.landing = GA4 Paid Search + Paid Social sessions. Walk-in = Store visits + Local actions - Directions + Local actions - Menu views + Clicks to call (no 'Click Book Now' action exists on this account).

problems: CREATE PATH BOUNDARY IS THIS WEEK. The pagePath split was run for Dubai for the first time. In 2026 sevenrooms_booking_complete fires on three routes: /explore/hutongdubai/reservations/create/checkout/, /explore/hutongdubai/reservations/modify/checkout/ and the /reservations/hutongdubai landing route. Only the modify route is excluded; no manage or prearrival rows exist at Dubai in either year. Amendment share of all booking events: 2026 W38 7 of 104 = 6.7%, W39 2 of 96 = 2.1%, W40 1 of 101 = 1.0%, W41 7 of 84 = 8.3%, four weeks combined 17 of 385 = 4.4%. 2025 W38 to W41: zero on all four weeks, 0 of 576, because the modify route did not exist on the 2025 site (all 2025 events fire on /reservations/hutongdubai, /reservations/hutongdubai/ or /reservations/hutongdubai/ig, all of which pass the filter). The create path therefore moves the 2026 side down and leaves 2025 unchanged, the opposite direction to London. On the old all-paths basis the current week would read 84 bookings and the YoY would be -36.8%; on the create path it is 77 and -42.1%.

Google Ads (7344894846) local and offline conversion action rows (Store visits, Local actions - Directions, Local actions - Menu views, Local actions - Orders, Local actions - Other engagements, Local actions - Website visits, Clicks to call) still return NO rows. Verified this run with a filtered query over 2026-09-21..2026-10-18: 'No results found for the query'. The gap has run unbroken since 13 Aug 2026, which is ten consecutive reporting weeks counting from the week of 10 Aug. All four t4_walkin_ty values are carried as null with payload gaps=true so the trends panel renders a gap and n/a. Not a zero. The same query shape returns the full local set for 2025, so the LY line is real.

GA4 average session duration jumped to 338s from 145s the week before while engagement rate fell to 66.8% from 72.7% and sessions fell 10.1%. That pairing is unusual and may be a measurement artefact rather than behaviour. GA4 bounce and engagement rate restate materially in the week after a run, so the current week's 66.8% is provisional. Worth a look before it is quoted anywhere.
